svg.title: NoPing Fortified Enterprise Fleet architecture
svg.desc: Mattermost and the NoPing plugin invoke a private Cloud Run organizational agent service using Google identity and HMAC. The service uses Google ADK, Gemini, Model Armor, Firestore, Pub/Sub, and Cloud observability. A separate budget guard may stop the small Mattermost VM at 90 percent of a 25 dollar budget.
